verdict.rationale: Polar documents an embedded checkout that keeps buyers on the merchant's own site, including an embedded payment-method view. It also offers a Checkout Session API with client-side get/update/confirm endpoints for API-driven flows. The 'customizable' part of the story is not evidenced: nothing describes styling, theming or component-level control of the embed, and there is only first-party documentation. missing for 10: documented customization/theming of embedded components, granular composable payment UI elements, independent or hands-on corroboration of the embed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: Our embedded checkout allows you to provide a seamless purchasing experience without redirecting users away from your site.
embedded checkout (embed.md — drop-in on your own site, including an embedded payment-method view)
If you want to integrate more deeply the checkout process with your website or application, you can use our dedicated API.
